import os, re, sys

path = "unpacked_report/word/document.xml"
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    xml = f.read()

# Extract all <w:p ...>...</w:p> blocks (non-greedy, but paragraphs can nest tables; use regex on pretty-printed lines instead)
lines = xml.splitlines()

# Track current paragraph buffer and its start line
paragraphs = []
current = []
start = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if "<w:p " in line or "<w:p>" in line:
        if current:
            paragraphs.append((start, "".join(current)))
        current = [line]
        start = i
    elif current is not None:
        current.append(line)
    if "</w:p>" in line and current is not None:
        paragraphs.append((start, "".join(current)))
        current = []
        start = None

# Identify headings: paragraphs whose pPr contains a pStyle with Title/Heading
heading_styles = ("Title", "Heading1", "Heading2", "Heading3", "Heading4", "Heading5", "Heading6", "Subtitle")
for lineno, text in paragraphs:
    m = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', text)
    if m and m.group(1) in heading_styles:
        # extract plain text from w:t and w:delText
        texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', text)
        plain = "".join(texts)
        print(f"LINE {lineno}: style={m.group(1)!r} text={plain!r}")

# Also print any paragraphs that don't have a heading style but might look like headlines (short, no ending period)
print("\n--- All pStyle values used ---")
styles = set()
for lineno, text in paragraphs:
    m = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', text)
    if m:
        styles.add(m.group(1))
print(sorted(styles))

        with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
        texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', content)
        print(p, "->", texts)
